column1: Summary

Final presentation (goals, process, outcomes, live demo of all core features), demo script, Thursday rehearsal and backup video. First-time-user check with two people outside the team F1, Obj-7, NFR-USE-01
User Guide complete, including an API section; Team Effort Estimation final with everyone's actual hours Documents 6 and 7
Full test pass on Wednesday and the final Test Report with its issue log NFR-QUA-01, 02, document 5
Source package: code, styling, database scripts and every resource needed to deploy; README runs on an empty machine; fresh demo seed Friday F2
Load check with several simultaneous users on the live server; results to Xander for the report NFR-PER-01
ADA checklist and a full screen reader and keyboard-only pass, with fixes; the UI polish the Plan had in It9. A one-page findings report NFR-A11Y-01 to 04, Obj-8, stretch goal

Security audit checklist and fixes: HTTPS deployment, Secure and HttpOnly cookie, login on every route, rate limiting on login, register and receipt upload, the admin boundary, secrets out of git. Publish the API reference at /api/docs NFR-SEC-01 to 08, O
Friday freeze close-out: full regression on the server, the stretch goal go or no-go, and Test Documentation and User Guide sections for this week's features NFR-QUA-01, 02

Tests: going over a goal is never blocked, the mid-month edit rule, analysis range and empty state, a recurring bill is added once per month, activity and notifications private to the people involved, and every blocked admin path FR-BUD-05, 06, FR-ANL-04,
Activity page and the admin login, dashboard and access-denied pages, from the mockups. Cole reviews FR-SOC-01, FR-ADM-01, 03, 07
Kickoff regression on the live server; file Iteration 7 leftovers as tickets. Record the Monday decisions in the Requirements Spec and JIRA NFR-QUA-01
Notifications in the bell menu with an unread badge, following the user's settings FR-SOC-02
Analysis page: month and range picker, category chart, metrics, and the empty state from the mockup FR-ANL-01, 03, 04, 05
Budget screens: personal or group, per person or total, a monthly goal per category, progress bars, an over-goal flag that never blocks FR-BUD-01, 03, 04, 06
Add Expense: category picker (four suggestions plus type your own), a due date and a "repeats monthly" option FR-EXP-01, 06, FR-BUD-02, FR-SPL-01

Admin routes: separate login checked against admin_users with the same generic error as user login, dashboard data, grant and revoke admin, and block and log any admin request for a user's data. Non-admins on admin routes are refused and logged FR-ADM-01

An activity row on every expense change, receipt confirm, settlement and membership change. Activity feed and notifications (unread count, mark as read) that honor each user's notification settings and show only their own rows FR-SOC-01, 02, NFR-SEC-07
Recurring bills: due date and monthly repeat on create, and a daily job that adds the next copy through the expense service FR-EXP-06, FR-SPL-01
Analysis endpoint for a month or a date range of up to 12 months, built on Mick's queries FR-ANL-01, 02, 04
Category on create, edit and receipt confirm. Budget and goal endpoints with the OI-09 edit rule, never blocking an expense FR-EXP-01, FR-BUD-01 to 06
Admin tables (admin_users, separate from users, and admin_access_log), the first-admin script, and the dashboard count queries FR-ADM-02, 03, 05, 07, OI-13, OI-15
Activity table with a read flag for notifications; index on user and time FR-SOC-01, 02
Recurring bills: repeat monthly, start date and next due date on expenses FR-EXP-06, FR-SPL-01
Analysis queries for a month or date range: spend by category, visits and average spend by store (from receipts), and each member's share against the group's configured split FR-ANL-02
Finish the budgets and budget_items stubs: a budget belongs to a user or a group for one month, one goal per category, and whether a group goal is per person or total FR-BUD-01, 03, 04
category text column on expenses, up to 30 characters. The suggestions live in the frontend FR-EXP-01, FR-BUD-02
It7-19 Cole Delete-picture dialog that states the items are kept. Mini receipt image for hand-entered expenses FR-EXP-31, OI-21
It7-18 Cole Settle Up screen: full or partial amount, a confirm step, and wording that the app records a payment made outside it and moves no money. Balances refresh after FR-SPL-13, 15, 17
It7-17 Cole Edit and delete expense, each with a confirmation that says what is lost and what is kept. Event picker on Add Expense FR-EXP-32, NFR-DAT-02, 03, FR-GRP-14

It7-16 Cole Review-and-assign screen: every item editable; assign each item to one or more people; unassigned items flagged; each person's total shown live before saving; cancel discards FR-EXP-20 to 25
It7-15 Cole Connect the chosen LLM/OCR reader in place of the Iteration 6 stand-in. Keep the JSON check and the one retry FR-EXP-13, 14
It7-14 Lukas Delete a receipt picture while keeping its items, and keep the picture if deletion fails. Let a receipt be attached to an existing expense FR-EXP-30, 31, 33, OI-21

It7-13 Lukas Settle up: record a full or partial payment, never more than what is owed, with the balance updated in the same transaction; list a group's settlements. Follow the OI-18 answer FR-SPL-13 to 16

It7-12 Lukas Edit and delete an expense: PUT and DELETE /expenses/{id}, with balances recalculated in the same transaction and the edit rule from Monday. Accept an optional event on create and edit FR-EXP-32, NFR-DAT-02, FR-GRP-14

POST /receipts/{id}/confirm: use the split calculator to turn item assignments into shares, then create the expense, splits and balances in one transaction. Flag and skip unassigned items. Mark the receipt confirmed and delete its picture.
It7-10 Lukas PUT /receipts/{id}/items: save corrected names, prices and quantities, and add or remove items FR-EXP-20, 21
It7-9 Mick Picture cleanup: delete the file and clear its path when items are confirmed. Add a script that removes unconfirmed pictures older than the agreed expiry FR-EXP-30, OI-17
It7-8 Mick Optional event_id on expenses, and retire the unused event paid, category and event_splits (ADR-05). Run the migration on an empty database and on the seeded one FR-GRP-14
It7-7 Mick Settlements table: group, who paid, who was paid, amount, who recorded it, when FR-SPL-13, 16
It7-6 Mick Item assignments table: one row per person per receipt item, with that person's share. Shares for an item add up to its line total. Replace the unused item_splits stub FR-EXP-22, 23, OI-16

It7-5 Xander Run the 15-receipt set against the chosen LLM/OCR reader and log the accuracy. Update the Test Documentation and write the User Guide sections for receipts and settling up NFR-PER-02, NFR-QUA-02

It7-4 Xander Tests for edit, delete and settle: a deleted expense reverses its balances, a partial settlement leaves the rest owed, a cancelled settlement changes nothing, no one can settle someone else's debt FR-EXP-32, FR-SPL-13 to 15, NFR-SEC-07

It7-3 Xander Write the review-math tests on Monday from hand-worked examples, before the code: an item shared by some people, unassigned items left out, shares that add up to the cent, cancel saves nothing FR-EXP-22 to 25, NFR-DAT-04
It7-2 Xander Collect the five Monday answers (LLM/OCR questions, OI-18, edit rights, FR-EXP-30, picture expiry). Record each in the Requirements Spec and close the JIRA question OI-03, OI-18
It7-1 Xander Run the Iteration 6 regression on the live server at kickoff. File every failure and every unfinished Iteration 6 task as a ticket NFR-QUA-01

It6-19 Xander Confirm the password complexity fix landed and has a test. Update the README (receipt setup, AI environment variables, pytest exception for OI-26) and add the design link FR-ACC-01 to FR-ACC-04, NFR-QUA-01

It6-18 Xander API tests for upload: good JPEG and PDF accepted; wrong type, oversize and corrupt file rejected with the right message; reading failure reported as its own state FR-EXP-10, FR-EXP-16, FR-EXP-17
It6-17 Cole "Check the items" button goes to a placeholder page. The real review screen is It7 FR-EXP-20
It6-16 Cole Error screens: upload failed (cause and fix) and could not read it (try another picture, take a new photo, enter by hand). Build from the mockup states FR-EXP-16, FR-EXP-17
It6-15 Cole "The AI is reading it" screen that polls the status, then the success summary: store, date, item count, total FR-EXP-12, FR-EXP-15

It6-14 Xander Build a test set of 15 receipts (clean, crumpled, dim, angled, PDF) with the expected store, date and items. Run the pipeline against it and report how many items it gets right FR-EXP-13, NFR-PER-02
It6-13 Cole Upload screen: file explorer on a laptop, camera and photo library on a phone, JPEG and PDF only FR-EXP-10, FR-EXP-11
It6-12 Cole Pipeline call: send the image, get back JSON with store location, items, per-item amounts and date. Validate the JSON shape and retry once if it is malformed FR-EXP-13, FR-EXP-14
It6-11 Lukas GET /receipts/{id}: status plus store, date and items, for the screen that polls while the AI reads FR-EXP-12, FR-EXP-15
It6-10 Lukas Pick up the unfinished It5 backend bugs from It6-1 (if none, help Xander with It6-14 test fixtures) NFR-QUA
It6-9 Lukas Login and membership checks on receipt routes. Files are never served from a public path NFR-SEC-03, NFR-SEC-04
It6-8 Lukas After upload, send the file to Cole's pipeline, save the JSON, set status to read or failed. A reading failure must look different from an upload failure FR-EXP-13, FR-EXP-14, FR-EXP-17
It6-7 Lukas Upload error responses that name the cause (wrong format, too large, corrupt file) and say what to do next FR-EXP-16
It6-6 Lukas POST /receipts: accept JPEG, PDF or camera image, check type and size, save the file, create the row, return its status FR-EXP-10, FR-EXP-12
It6-5 Mick Replace seed.py with a script that creates demo users through the app's own password hashing, so seeded logins work NFR-SEC-02
It6-4 Mick Add a receipt_items table: receipt_id, name, quantity, unit price, line total, position. The starter models.py flagged these missing columns FR-EXP-13, FR-EXP-15

It6-3 Mick Add a receipts table: id, uploader, optional expense_id, file path, file type, size, status (uploaded, reading, read, failed), store, store location, receipt date. Alembic migration, run on a clean database FR-EXP-12, FR-EXP-13, FR-EXP-15
It6-2 Xander Settle OI-03 (which AI reader), OI-16, OI-17 and OI-21 with the team by Wed Nov 4, then record each answer in the Requirements Spec OI-03, OI-16, OI-17, OI-21
It6-1 Xander Run the It5 regression suite at kickoff. File every demo bug and every sponsor or instructor comment as a ticket NFR-QUA
Demo Week
Figma final pass, link in README (view mode), README updated to show built vs planned (2h) —
Full dry run Wednesday, start to finish without stopping; note fixes (1h) —
Full regression run, plus a demo-day checklist (fresh database, Docker running, backup screen recording) completed that morning (3h) —
Demo script: who presents what, in what order, with a time limit per section, read by the whole team by Tuesday (3h) —
Check every demo screen on a phone and a laptop; nothing breaks at phone width (2h) NFR-CMP-01, 02, 03, 04
Consistency pass across built screens: spacing, buttons, error messages (8h) NFR-A11Y-02
Fix every bug filed from the It4 regression run; no open bugs on demo features (8h) —
Demo seed script: 3 users with real working passwords, one roommate group, one event, 8–10 expenses using all three split methods. Fresh database to demo-ready in under a minute (4h) —

Figma: high-fidelity versions of all seven screens using the styles page, linked into a clickable prototype from home to every screen and back (8h) FR-EXP-10–33, FR-SPL-13–17, FR-BUD, FR-ANL, FR-ADM, FR-SOC
Run It3 regression suite at kickoff; post results, file failures (1h) —
Settle the four expense questions with the team by Monday: removed members' expenses, event balances, saved ratios, multi-group expenses (2h) OI-05, OI-07, OI-19, OI-20
Unit tests for expense and balance routes, including "can't see another group's balances" (6h) —
Unit tests for the split calculator: all three methods, rounding, mismatched totals (6h) —
Balances page matching GET /balances, with "you owe" and "owes you" separated (6h) FR-SPL-12
Split picker with live per-person preview. Blocks submit if amounts don't add up; can switch from autosplit to manual (8h) FR-SPL-06, 07, 08, 10
Add expense screen with every It4-5 field. Cancel discards; no group shows a create-group prompt (10h) FR-EXP-01, 02, 04, 05
GET /groups/{id}/expenses, newest first, members only (3h) FR-EXP-02, NFR-SEC-07
GET /balances, limited to the user's own groups (6h) FR-SPL-11, NFR-SEC-07
POST /expenses: save, calculate shares, and update balances together or not at all. A user with no group gets told to create one (10h) FR-EXP-01, 02, 03, 05
Split calculator: even, custom, percentage. Mismatched totals rejected; leftover cents go to one member and get flagged; $10 three ways gives 3.34 / 3.33 / 3.33 (8h) FR-SPL-04, 06, 07, 08
categories table seeded with food, rent, entertainment, other (3h) FR-EXP-01
Add amount columns to splits and balances, closing the gaps listed in models.py (4h) FR-SPL-03, 11
expenses and expense_participants tables. An expense must belong to a group or an event (6h) FR-EXP-01, 02, FR-GRP-14

Figma: styles page copied from the built app (Bootstrap colors, font, buttons, fields), plus low-fidelity wireframes for all seven unbuilt screens, shared at Friday close-out (6h) FR-EXP-10–33, FR-SPL-13–17, FR-BUD, FR-ANL, FR-ADM, FR-SOC
README and user guide: groups and events, followable by someone new (2h) —
Run It2 regression suite at kickoff; post results at standup, file failures as JIRA bugs (1h) —
Unit tests: create group, invite/accept/decline, all three removal cases, event with zero members. All pass in pytest (6h) —
Pending invites on the home page with accept/decline. Accepting shows the group without a refresh (3h) FR-GRP-03, 07
Create event screen with member checkboxes. Submit disabled at zero selected; cancel discards (4h) FR-GRP-13, 15, 16
Group settings: member list with status, add, remove with balance warning, reassign admin. Every It3-6 route reachable from this page (8h) FR-GRP-08, 09, 11, 12
Create group screen: name, type dropdown, invite field. Cancel saves nothing; success lands on the group page (6h) FR-GRP-01, 03, 06
POST /events with a member subset. Zero members or anyone outside the group gets 422 (4h) FR-GRP-13, 15

Add/remove member with balance check. Zero balance removes immediately; non-zero warns unless confirmed; sole admin can't remove themselves. Test the non-zero path with a stub until balances exist in It4 (8h) FR-GRP-08, 09, 10, 11, 12

Invite by email or username, plus accept/decline routes. Declining adds no membership; inviting the same person twice gets 409; an unknown email creates a registration invite (logged, not emailed, for now) (8h) FR-GRP-03, 04, 05, 07
POST /groups: create with type, creator added as admin. 201 on success, bad type gets 422, logged out gets 401 (5h) FR-GRP-01, 02
events and event_members tables. Deleting a group deletes its events (3h) FR-GRP-13, 14

groups table (name, type: roommate/partner/family/outing, created_by) and group_members (is_admin, invite_status: pending/accepted/declined). Migration runs on a clean database, and a user can't be in the same group twice (4h) FR-GRP-01, 03, 12
